text: You'll love this Tomato and Basil Orzo Salad recipe, which checks all your boxes. As a vegetarian, you'll appreciate that it's free from animal products, and since you're also nut-free, you don't have to worry about any potential allergens. The combination of orzo pasta, fresh tomatoes, and basil is a classic and flavorful one, and the addition of parmesan cheese provides a nice salty kick. With a cooking time of just 35 minutes, it's also quick and easy to prepare, fitting within your 45-minute time budget.
